import requests

response = requests.get(
  "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/xyz.json"
)
print(response.status_code)   # 200 means success
data = response.json()        # parses the JSON body
caption: NYC's own Open Data portal exposes a real API — genuine data with no file to download.
Exceptions catch a crash. Status codes tell you the request completed but might not have succeeded.

eyebrow: Pagination — Lesson 17's while loop, for real
code:
all_records = []
offset = 0
while True:
    response = requests.get(f"...?$limit=1000&$offset={offset}")
    page = response.json()
    if not page:
        break
    all_records.extend(page)
    offset = offset + 1000
caption: You don't know how many pages exist in advance — exactly why while, not for.

subtitle: When the shape isn't a simple flat list.
